Project Architect / Senior Architectural Designer
														
																
																			SRAA+E
																										
								Employer:
												New York, NY, USLocation:
						Fri, Nov 13 '26Posted on:
													Full-timeType:									
						                        
					 
				 
				
We are seeking an experienced Senior Architectural Designer / Project Architect with 6 to 8 years of professional experience, including substantial experience with NYC projects, building code, zoning, construction documentation, and consultant coordination.
The selected candidate will take on a senior role across a broad range of project types, including new buildings, adaptive reuse, commercial, retail, mixed-use, and multi-family residential projects. This position requires strong design and technical abilities, sound professional judgment, and the ability to work independently while coordinating with internal teams, clients, consultants, and contractors.
  
The ideal candidate should be capable of leading design development, preparing and coordinating construction document sets, resolving technical issues, and managing project responsibilities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  
Qualifications
  
- Bachelor      of Architecture required; Master of Architecture preferred.
  
- Architectural      license preferred but not required.
  
- 6      to 8 years of experience in a mid-size to large architecture or      A&E firm preferred.
  
- Significant      experience with NYC projects, including building code, zoning      analysis, DOB filing coordination, and construction documentation.
  
- Ability      to develop and coordinate construction document sets, including plans,      sections, details, wall sections, façade detailing, schedules, and      consultant information.
  
- Experience      with both ground-up construction and adaptive reuse / renovation      of existing buildings.
  
- Experience      coordinating with MEP, structural, civil, façade, lighting, and specialty      consultants.
  
- Ability      to perform zoning and code analysis and translate regulatory requirements      into coordinated design and documentation.
  
- Experience      with construction administration tasks, including shop drawing review,      submittals, RFIs, and field coordination.
  
- Ability      to mentor junior staff and help coordinate internal production workflows.
  
- Strong      design sensibility, graphic judgment, and ability to prepare presentation      materials for clients and internal design reviews.
  
- Ability      to create design presentation renderings for a variety of commercial      project types, including retail, mixed-use, and multi-family residential      projects.
  
- Strong      organizational, presentation, verbal, and written communication skills.
  
- Ability      to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple deadlines.
 
Required Software Skills
  
Drafting
  
- AutoCAD      LT 2026, full proficiency required
 
Adobe Creative Suite
  
- Photoshop,      full proficiency required
  
- InDesign,      full proficiency required
 
3D Modeling
  
- Rhino,      full proficiency required
  
- SketchUp
 
Visualization
  
- Enscape,      full proficiency required
  
- V-Ray
 
Microsoft Office Suite
  
- Word
  
- Excel,      full proficiency required
  
- PowerPoint
 
Additional Skills
  
- MS      Project is a plus.
  
- Revit      experience is a plus.
  
- Experience      with DOB NOW, BIS, zoning diagrams, and filing coordination is a plus.
 
 About Our Office
Our office is located in the vibrant Hudson Square neighborhood, just two blocks from Pier 34 on the Hudson River. We offer subsidized health insurance and paid vacation on an accrual basis. Growth and salary opportunities are commensurate with experience, performance, and demonstrated leadership.
 
Please send your resume, salary requirements, and a small portfolio to [email protected].  Recommended portfolio file size: 10 MB or less.
